verses.text: Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá, ix schaanel yich winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 12 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, palta maj k'och wal ijan chukal ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh yik smam snun. Yujto ix sjuel jun k'een k'een winh yik Baal sb'onakkan winh smam winh chi'.
Wach'chom icha chi', palta ix sb'eyb'alejnhej schukal b'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat winh, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.

Ha winhaj Mesa sreyal Moab, molum kalnel winh yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Yuj chi' a nok' syak' winh yik stupan winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', 100 mil nok' yunetak kalnel yet' pax 100 mil nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' slanail syak' winh.
Palta ayik ix cham winhaj Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a winh sreyal Moab chi' t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.
Yuj chi', ix el winhaj Joram t'a Samaria, ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado yik Israel winh.

Elanhchamel ix yalb'at winh t'a winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá: Ha winh sreyal Moab toxo ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a yalanh in mandar, ¿tzam yal a k'ol tzach och wet'ok yik skak'an owal yet' winh? xchib'at winh. Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Judá chi' icha tik: Ol in b'at het'ok yet' heb' in soldado yet' nok' in chej.
Anhej b'ian, ¿tas b'eal b'aj ol onh b'atok? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Joram chi' ix yalan winh: Ha t'a sb'eal takinh lu'um t'a yol yik Edom, hata' ol onh b'atok, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winh sreyal Israel yet' winh sreyal Judá yet' pax winh sreyal Edom yet' heb' soldado. Uke' k'ual ix b'ey heb' yujto ix ek' yoymitej lum takinh lum chi' heb', yuj chi' ix lajwiel ha' yaal heb' soldado syuk'ej yet' pax yik masanil snok' heb' yet'nak.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, ichato onh smolb'ej Jehová a onh oxwanh rey onh tik yik tzonh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Moab tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --¿Mama junok winh schekab' Jehová ayek' t'a tik yik wach' sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová kuuj? xchi winh. Ay jun winh yajal soldado yaj t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' ix tak'wi icha tik: --Ha t'a tik ayek' winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat. Haton winh schekab'kan winhaj Elías, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh chi' yel schekab' Jehová yaj winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at oxwanh heb' winh rey chi' lolonel yet' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Palta ix yalan winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --¿Tas walan wik t'ayach? Ixik, b'at k'anb'ej a b'a t'a heb' winh schekab' sdiosalkan heb' a mam a nun, xchi winh. Palta ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi': --Maay, yujto onh ik'jikot yuj Jehová a onh oxwanh rey onh tik, yik tzonh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' moabita, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --T'a wal yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil swala', haton jun swak' serwil, q'uinalok malaj yelk'och winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá tik t'a yol in sat, manh jab'ok tzin cha wab' tas tzala', max in ochpax k'elan jab'ok t'ayach.

Ik'ekkot junok mach syal schalan te' arpa t'a wichanh tik, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot jun winh syal schalan te' arpa chi' heb' winh. Ayik wan schalan te' arpa chi' winh, ix jawi yipalil Jehová t'a winhaj Eliseo chi',
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: B'oek tzijtumok sanja t'a jun ch'olan tik.
Wach'chom malaj ik', ma nhab' ol eyil sjawi, palta a jun ch'olan tik ol b'ut'jok yuj ha ha', yuj chi' he masanil ol eyuk' ha', ol yuk'an ha' nok' he wakax yet' pax nok' he chej, xchi Jehová.
Chekelnhej wal yaj jun tik t'a yichanh tas ol sk'ulej Jehová, ol yak'och heb' moabita chi' t'a yol he k'ab'.

Yuj chi' ol he juem lanhnaj schonhab' heb' wach' yajoch smuroal yet' juntzanh niwak chonhab' wach' yilji. Ol he ch'akanem masanil yawb'en te' heb', ol laj he mukankan sjaj ha' yuk'lab' ha' heb', ol he b'ut'ankan sat slum heb' yet' k'een k'een b'aj smunlaji, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Haxo ix aji, ha t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, icha yorail tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová, ha t'a yol yik Edom, ix kot ha ha', ix b'ut'jiel sat lum lum chi' yuj ha'.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' moabita to wan sk'och heb' winh rey yak' owal yet' heb', ix smolb'an masanil heb' winh kelemtak heb' yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, heb' winh syal yoch t'a owal, ix och heb' winh smak t'a sat smojon snakión chi'.
Ayik ix k'e wan heb' moabita chi' t'a q'uinhib'alil, ix yilan heb' toxonhej skopopi yilji yib'anh ha ha' chi' yuj yok k'u, ichato chik'xonhej yilji ha'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ha jun chi' chik'. Tope a heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh soldado ix smil-lajcham sb'a. Ha tiknaik koyek sb'at kik'ankan masanil tastak yet'nak heb' ix kani, xchi heb'.

Palta haxo ix jawi heb' moabita t'a skampamento heb' israel, ix elta heb' israel chi' yak' owal yet' heb', ix ak'ji ganar heb' moabita chi' yuj heb'. Yuj chi' ix el heb' elelal, palta ix och heb' israel chi' t'a spatik heb', ix miljicham heb' yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sjuanem lanhnaj schonhab' heb' moabita chi' heb', ix sb'ut'an lum lum heb' t'a k'een k'een, haton lum te yax sat yik munlajel. Ix smukan sjajtak ha ha' heb', ix sch'akanel masanil te' awb'en te' heb' te wach'. Haxonhej chonhab' Kir-hareset ixto kani, palta haxo heb' sjulwaj yet' ch'anh mejmeech, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ayik ix yilan winh sreyal Moab to wan yak'ji ganar winh t'a owal chi', ix yik'ankot 700 heb' soldado winh, heb' te jelan yak'an owal yet' k'een espada. Ix yekanoch sb'a heb' t'a skal heb' soldado yik sk'och heb' b'aj ayek' winh sreyal Edom chi', yik smilancham winh heb' yalani, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot jun sb'ab'el yuninal winh sreyal Moab chi', haton jun t'inhan yochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix snhusantz'a winh silab'il t'a sdiosal t'a yib'anh smuroal schonhab' chi'. Te chuk ix aj snaan heb' winh israel chi' yuj jun chi', yuj chi' ix yik'k'e waan skampamento heb' winh, ix pax heb' winh t'a schonhab'.
